title: Digital workbooks
introduction: Computer science workbooks from HU Berlin, free to use. Choose a topic and work directly in your browser.
digitalDescription: These digital editions are in development. Start without an account and save answers locally, or sign in to synchronize them.
standaloneDescription: Standalone learning activities with their own controls and storage. External activities open in a new tab.
owner: Responsible for content: Computer Science and Society, HU Berlin, Unter den Linden 6, 10117 Berlin. Contact: andre.greubel@hu-berlin.de.
plant-description: Plan, build and program automatic irrigation.
blockchain-title: Bitcoin — the currency of the future?
blockchain-description: Explore transactions, mining and the energy demands of blockchains.
images-description: Experiment with pixels, weights and the limits of image recognition.
monks-title: Recursion with the monks of Mons Komputarius
monks-description: Discover recursion in two stories and draw Koch curves. Workbook in German.
embroidery-title: Learn programming with an embroidery machine
embroidery-description: Design patterns and draw shapes with turtle programs.
compression-description: Explore lossless and lossy compression. Workbook in German.
phishing-description: Inspect messages, domains and attachments in a mail simulator.
scratch-description: Program your own game step by step.
caesar-description: Learn programming with encryption and PRIMM activities.
qr-title: How is a QR code created?
qr-description: Explore how QR codes are structured and generated.
python-description: Learn Python with turtle examples and PRIMM activities.
compression-lab-description: Try compression techniques in the standalone learning activity.
evacuation-description: Construct floors, compare locker and door layouts, and question evacuation models.
